title: My dad just told me he used to have mallworld dreams
content: Well not exactly in that wording but he described being excited every night to fall asleep and go to a dreamland which he described exactly like the mallworld. The only reason why I’m mentioning this is that I actually only started having these dreams within the past few years and can remember the first one I had. I was on a plot of land that I remember was the setting of the suburban neighborhood closest to the city, except it was before any of its construction. It was just a single house, “given” to me in the dream by my dad and his parents, almost like a rite of passage (I’ve never seen them in the mallworld after this one dream). It was an old wooden house that was deteriorated to the point of decay, and I knew it was my task to fix it up. No idea how this connects to anything, I just thought it was really cool.
